visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-04-10
Patient: 60-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: worsening leg weakness with low back pain
History: low back pain for a week; foot drop developing over the last 48 hours.
Examination: ankle dorsiflexion 2/5, clearly weaker than two days ago.
Assessment: progressive motor deficit, lumbar nerve root compression suspected.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine this afternoon. Because the weakness is progressing, imaging could not be delayed.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-04-10.

supporting_documents.text:
Billing note, 2026-05-21
Authorization was not requested before the scan because of the urgency.
No record found of a notification to the plan after the scan.

missing_evidence: record that the plan was notified within 2 business days of the service
expected.rationale: The note documents why the scan could not wait, which is half of what the urgent-service clause requires. The other half, notifying the plan within 2 business days, is not shown either way, so the appeal cannot be written yet.
